name: Vince Kurtz
title: Assistant Professor
department: School of Computing, Jarvis College of Computing and Digital Media
fitReason: Strong algorithmic match in generative predictive control and risk-aware learned navigation, with real prior-institution robot collaboration. New DePaul lab access and short-visitor capacity need separate confirmation.

physicalEvidence.summary: June 2025 Risk-Guided Diffusion validates learned NoMaD navigation with physics-based traversability guidance on a NeBula Spot at JPL’s Mars Yard; Carter results are simulated. Real-world hazards/failures remain nonzero, so the abstract’s safety language is not a universal guarantee. Kurtz was a Caltech coauthor then; this does not establish DePaul ownership or access. The 2026 ICRA Generative Predictive Control paper explicitly leaves hardware validation to future work, so it is not treated as a physical flow-policy experiment.

shortVisit.summary: Current personal page and DePaul robotics faculty listing confirm Assistant Professor, starting January 2026. Detailed intake advertises a Fall2027 PhD position and research for currently enrolled DePaul master’s/undergraduate students. It does not offer an external master’s short visit.

scoreReasons.fit: Direct generative control and risk-guided learned navigation, with a strong computational focus.
scoreReasons.physical: Verified JPL Spot trials as prior Caltech collaborator; current DePaul hardware not established.
scoreReasons.shortVisit: Published master’s intake restricted to current DePaul students, plus PhD admissions; no external visitor invitation.
scoreReasons.freshness: Current2026 DePaul appointment and July 2026 primary flow-matching methods; physical navigation is correctly dated2025.
